queries.title: Queries
queries.description: Optional keyword filter matched against the listing card text (title, company, location). Leave empty to take the recently-posted feed as-is and filter downstream.

maxJobs.title: Max Jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum postings to save. Each saved posting costs one page load through the proxy.

timeFilter.title: Time Filter
timeFilter.description: Keep postings whose posted date falls inside this window. Postings without a parseable date are kept.

maxScrolls.title: Max Scrolls
maxScrolls.description: How many times to scroll the recently-posted list to load more cards before starting.

requestDelaySecs.title: Request Delay (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: Pause between posting page loads. Cloudflare notices bursts more than pace.

headless.title: Headless
headless.description: Run a truly headless browser. Keep OFF on Apify: the image runs under xvfb, so 'headful' needs no display, and Cloudflare hard-blocks the headless fingerprint. Only turn on for local debugging.

listingAttempts.title: Listing Attempts
listingAttempts.description: How many proxy sessions to try when Cloudflare blocks the listing. A WAF block burns the IP, so each attempt gets a fresh session.

proxyGroups.title: Apify Proxy Groups
proxyGroups.description: Proxy groups used when proxyConfiguration is not supplied. Residential is what Cloudflare expects; BUYPROXIES94952 / StaticUS3 are cheaper fallbacks.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Full proxy configuration. Overrides proxyGroups when supplied.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch Full Descriptions
fetchDetails.description: Open each posting for description/salary/apply URL. OFF by default: Cloudflare hard-blocks /job/* and /jobs/* even for real Chrome + residential proxy (verified 2026-11-25), so list-only mode is the working, honest configuration.
